description: Search your logs and run metrics queries, create, change and switch off monitors, look after collectors, export library content, and list dashboards, scheduled views, users, roles and health events in Sumo Logic. Start workflows when a monitor alert is raised or resolved, a log message matches a query, a health event appears, a user joins or a collector stops reporting.

sumo_logic_collector_stopped_trigger.description: Runs when a Sumo Logic collector stops reporting (no heartbeat for 30 minutes). One that comes back and stops again runs it again. Collectors already stopped when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

sumo_logic_monitor_alert_trigger.description: Runs when a Sumo Logic monitor goes into an alert state (critical, warning or missing data), with the monitor's name and the state. A monitor that recovers and alerts again runs it again. Alerts already raised when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.name: The monitor's name.
output.path: Where the monitor is in the monitors library.
output.status: The alert state: Critical, Warning or MissingData.

parameters.description: Only this monitor. Leave blank for every monitor. Picking one lets Sumo Logic tell Lodol at once, through a webhook Lodol adds to the monitor's notifications while the workflow is on.
parameters.name: monitor_id

parameters.description: Only alerts of this kind: Critical, Warning or MissingData. Leave blank for all three.
parameters.name: severity

sumo_logic_monitor_resolved_trigger.description: Runs when a Sumo Logic monitor leaves an alert state, because the problem cleared or the monitor was turned off, with the monitor's name and the state it left. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.name: The monitor's name.
output.path: Where the monitor is in the monitors library.
output.resolved_from: The state it left: Critical, Warning or MissingData.

parameters.description: Only this monitor. Leave blank for every monitor. Picking one lets Sumo Logic tell Lodol at once, through a webhook Lodol adds to the monitor's notifications while the workflow is on.
parameters.name: monitor_id

parameters.description: Only alerts of this kind: Critical, Warning or MissingData. Leave blank for all three.
parameters.name: severity

sumo_logic_new_health_event_trigger.description: Runs when Sumo Logic reports a new health event: a collector, source or ingest budget that has run into trouble. Events already open when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.resource_id: The id of what it happened to.
output.resource_name: The name of what it happened to.
output.subsystem: The product area, such as Ingest.

parameters.description: Only events of this severity: Error or Warning. Leave blank for both.
parameters.name: severity

parameters.description: Only events about this kind of thing: Collector, Source, IngestBudget or Organisation. Leave blank for all.
parameters.name: resource_type

sumo_logic_new_log_message_trigger.description: Runs for each new log message a search query matches, such as every error from one service. It searches the last 30 minutes at most every five minutes, and each search counts towards your Sumo Logic search use. Messages already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.fields: Every field of the message, by name.
output.source_name: The source's name, such as a file path.

parameters.description: A log search query without aggregates, such as _sourceCategory=prod/web error.
parameters.name: query

sumo_logic_new_user_trigger.description: Runs when someone is added to your Sumo Logic organization, with their name, email and roles. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.role_ids: The ids of their roles, separated by commas.
